about_the_game:
Skool Days is a narrative life simulation game set in a vibrant high school full of emotions, secrets, and choices.

You’re the new student in town, starting a fresh year full of possibilities. Between exams, friendships, and moments that shape who you’ll become, you’ll need to balance your studies, social life, and personal growth to make it through the school year.

Each day brings new challenges — will you focus on your grades, hang out with friends, or get involved in clubs and after-school activities? Every decision affects your relationships, reputation, and the way your story unfolds.

Inspired by classic life sims and narrative adventures, Skool Days blends emotional storytelling, time management, and expressive visuals to capture the spirit of adolescence — where every smile, mistake, and memory matters.

🏫 Key Features:

  • 🎓 High school simulator: attend classes, take exams, join clubs, and enjoy school events.

  • 💬 Dynamic relationships: meet unique classmates with distinct personalities and form friendships, rivalries, or even something more.

  • 🕒 Time management gameplay: plan your days wisely — what you do affects your story.

  • ❤️ Emotional storytelling: moments of humor, drama, and connection that feel real.

  • 🔁 Multiple endings: your choices shape how your year — and your future — will end.

  • 🎨 Expressive art style: colorful visuals and character design focused on emotion and mood.

In Skool Days, grades matter... but feelings matter even more.

Discover who you are, build meaningful friendships, and survive the highs and lows of teenage life — one class, one choice, one day at a time.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 (2018) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Metal support. Not compatible with macOS older than 10.15
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel i7 (2019)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD and Retina display (or 1080p) recommended

name: Skool Days

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU compatible with Unity URP/HDRP (2022+)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD and Full HD resolution recommended
